German Excellence
Sep 2026 • Couples
Absolutely fantastic food. Everything we ordered was incredibly authentic, flavorful, and clearly prepared with care. The schnitzel was perfectly crisp and tender, the red cabbage was delicious, and the rich, comforting flavors of the goulash were outstanding. This is the kind of food that feels genuinely traditional rather than adapted for tourists.
Just as importantly, the staff were exceptionally warm, friendly, and welcoming. It was one of those meals where both the food and hospitality make you want to come back. Easily one of the best meals we’ve had in the area. Highly recommended.
Written September 19, 2026
